prior_summary: Predict redundant fresh-source and fresh-bowl relative TCP positions with absolute world 6D orientation, then causally blend the two reconstructed positions from source elevation and finger closure before verified IK.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when source displacement is a concern but accurate source and bowl poses are observed, and when finger width plus source elevation reliably separate open/low acquisition from clear-lift transport. The handle geometry must match and all targets must remain reachable.
termination_guidance: Use physical finger closure, source/TCP co-motion, table clearance, upright posture and bowl-relative staging for handoff. Do not use the deterministic phase weight as contact evidence. The complete [180,360) overlap supports controlled_pour_and_right entry after secure lift or nominal high staging.
limitations: The causal blend is a phase proxy, not contact truth; dual labels may cost sample efficiency. No miss/slip recovery, obstacle avoidance or unreachable displacement is established. Absolute world orientation assumes the demonstrated grasp geometry and gravity direction remain relevant.
